# Test fixtures

`jira-header.png` is a synthetic English Jira-style header drawn locally with macOS AppKit, not a screenshot of a real issue. It contains `DEV-42`, `Fix login when opening a second window`, and `Type: Bug`, plus status/description labels. It tests the actual OCR engine without private data. It does not represent a real Jira-layout accuracy corpus.

The JSON fixtures preserve the pre-migration task/code-history version 1.0 backup shapes. The updater payload/signature support native signature-verification tests.
